resource_census.scope: Implementation-derived named capacities and phase coexistence, not a measured complete physical peak.
resource_census.explanation: The experimental mixed backend deliberately retains CPU protocol scratch outside the CUDA arena. During A commitment the GPU reservation plus CPU coset alone exceeds the final 6.442 GB all-temporaries contract. This is a disclosed resource limitation, not dynamic inference spill, a new target or a reason to block local integration. GPU reservation/payload subtotals must not be double-counted; cumulative samples must not be summed.
